content: KIS Open API uses appkey+appsecret to issue an access_token valid for 24h (reissued/refreshable ~every 6h). Order/cancel/modify (non-query) requests additionally require a hashkey. Mock (모의투자) account has lower REST rate limits than live. Implication: cache the token to disk with an expiry buffer; do not re-issue per request (issuance is rate-limited).
